page.overview:
Who is Amber Bennett?

Reginald Vel Johnson High School Student (graduated) Soup Kitchen Worker

William Clockwell Eve Wilkins Rick Sheridan Kyle (boyfriend)

Amber Justine Bennett is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

She is a high school student and social justice advocate who becomes the girlfriend, and later ex-girlfriend, of Mark Grayson.
